Yellow Bird Coffee

A full redesign for Yellow Bird Coffee as a school project, including a new website and a dedicated Instagram concept with product photography, video, and creative production.

View prototype ↗

About the project

This project was created as part of my Multimedia Design education and focused on Yellow Bird Coffee. We developed a new website for the brand and created a stronger digital presence through a more refined visual identity and a clearer online experience. We also built a social media concept for Instagram, where we photographed products, created video content, and developed a more editorial and cohesive visual language. The work included both storytelling and production, with a focus on making the brand feel more premium, approachable, and consistent across channels. The project combined research, brand direction, content creation, and digital design, giving us the opportunity to work across the full creative process from concept to execution.
